description: Plain-language names for everything the UI shows. The engine's own wording is kept beside each entry, never instead of it: this file is what the interface says, options.schema.json is what h3 accepts.

prompt.name: What the video shows
prompt.help: Describe the scene in a sentence. What is in it, what moves, how it is filmed.

seconds.name: How long
seconds.help: The length of the video. Lengths come in fixed steps, so the number is rounded up to the nearest one.
seconds.time: longer videos take proportionally longer to make

frames.name: How long, in frames
frames.help: The same setting counted in frames instead of seconds. 24 frames make a second.
frames.time: longer videos take proportionally longer to make

width.name: Shape
width.help: How wide and tall the video is. Widescreen for a screen, vertical for a phone.
width.time: twice the area is roughly twice the wait

height.name: Shape
height.help: How wide and tall the video is. Widescreen for a screen, vertical for a phone.
height.time: twice the area is roughly twice the wait

render_width.name: Work smaller, then enlarge
render_width.help: Draw at a smaller size and scale the result up. Much faster, and fine detail is lost.

render_height.name: Work smaller, then enlarge
render_height.help: Draw at a smaller size and scale the result up. Much faster, and fine detail is lost.

steps.name: Detail passes
steps.help: How many times the picture is refined. More passes bring out more detail.
steps.time: each pass adds a fixed amount of time

dit_layers.name: Model depth
dit_layers.help: How much of the model runs. Less is faster and a little looser.
dit_layers.time: cutting five layers saves a few percent

denoise_reuse.name: How often it redraws
denoise_reuse.help: Redrawing at every pass is closest to the reference. Redrawing less often is faster, and the framing can shift.
denoise_reuse.time: can save around a third of the drawing time

core_reuse.name: How often it redraws the main part
core_reuse.help: Keeps the quick work fresh at every pass and runs the expensive part less often. An alternative to redrawing less often, not a companion to it.

token_reduction.name: Pair up detail while drawing
token_reduction.help: Treats neighbouring detail as one while drawing. Faster, and the composition can drift. Leave it off at small sizes.
token_reduction.time: saves roughly a quarter of the drawing time

ssd_streaming.name: Use less graphics memory
ssd_streaming.help: Reads the model from disk as it goes instead of holding it all in memory. The result is identical; it takes longer.
ssd_streaming.time: about 38 % slower, and needs 1.6 GB instead of 27 GB

use_int8_row_fc2.name: Faster maths on Apple M5
use_int8_row_fc2.help: A shortcut that only exists on Apple's M5 chips. On this machine it changes nothing.

use_reference_rope.name: Original layout grid
use_reference_rope.help: Restores the layout grid as first released, for comparing against reference results.

seed.name: Variation
seed.help: Two videos made with the same settings and the same variation come out the same. Change it to get a different take on the same description.

first_frame.name: Start from a photo
first_frame.help: The video begins at this picture.

last_frame.name: End on a photo
last_frame.help: The video ends at this picture.

ref_image.name: Reference photo
ref_image.help: A photo to take the subject, the look or the setting from. The order of references matters.

ref_video.name: Reference clip
ref_video.help: A clip to continue or take the look from, keeping its sound.

ref_silent_video.name: Reference clip, without its sound
ref_silent_video.help: The same, but the clip's own audio is ignored.

ref_video_audio.name: Reference clip with a different soundtrack
ref_video_audio.help: A clip for the picture and a separate file for the sound.

ref_audio.name: Reference sound
ref_audio.help: A sound to take the mood or the music from. It needs a photo or a clip beside it, and must last between 2 and 15 seconds.

reference_image_size.name: How reference photos are sized
reference_image_size.help: Match keeps each photo at the video's shape. Max keeps as much of the photo as the model allows.

frames_dir.name: Save every frame
frames_dir.help: Writes each finished frame as a separate picture file, next to the video.

preview.name: Watch it being made
preview.help: Shows the picture after every pass, so you can stop early if it is going the wrong way.
preview.time: adds a short setup and a moment per pass

profile.name: Record timings
profile.help: Writes how long each stage took into the job's log.

slower.name: Reference-exact mode
slower.help: Forces the slowest, closest-to-reference way of computing each part. For comparing against reference numbers, not for making videos.

output.name: Where the video goes
output.help: The server picks a folder for each job.

model_dir.name: Model folder
model_dir.help: Set once when the service starts.

errors.match: a prompt is required
errors.title: Tell it what to show first.
errors.fix: Describe the scene in a sentence — what is in it, what moves, how it is filmed.

errors.match: width and height must be multiples of 32
errors.title: That size is not one the model can draw.
errors.fix: Width and height both have to be multiples of 32, and at least 32. Pick a shape above, or round your numbers to the nearest 32.

errors.match: canvas exceeds the released 768*1344 pixel limit
errors.title: That size is larger than the model can make.
errors.fix: The largest is 1344 × 768, however you arrange it. Pick a smaller shape.

errors.match: render width and height must be set together
errors.title: The smaller working size needs both numbers.
errors.fix: Set the working width and height together, or turn the option off.

errors.match: internal render canvas must be same-aspect
errors.title: The smaller working size has to match the shape of the video.
errors.fix: Use the same proportions as the output, in multiples of 32, and never larger than it.

errors.match: --seconds and --frames are mutually exclusive
errors.title: Choose one way to set the length.
errors.fix: Set the length in seconds or in frames, not both.

errors.match: invalid seconds
errors.title: That length is not a number the model can use.
errors.fix: Use a length between 0.9 and 15.1 seconds.

errors.match: frames must align within the released 5..362 range
errors.title: That length is outside what the model was released for.
errors.fix: Videos run from about 0.9 to about 15.1 seconds. Pick a length in that range.

errors.match: generation requires at least one trained 22-frame decoder chunk
errors.title: That video would be too short to make.
errors.fix: The shortest the model can produce is 22 frames, just under a second.

errors.match: denoising steps must be in [2, 1000]
errors.title: That number of detail passes is out of range.
errors.fix: Use between 2 and 1000 passes. Twenty is the usual choice.

errors.match: denoise reuse must be in [1, 3]
errors.title: That amount of reuse is out of range.
errors.fix: Reuse between passes goes from 1 (none) to 3 (a lot).

errors.match: DiT layers must be in [35, 50]
errors.title: That model depth is out of range.
errors.fix: Depth goes from 35 to 50. Fifty runs the whole model.

errors.match: core reuse must be in [1, 6]
errors.title: That amount of reuse is out of range.
errors.fix: Reusing the heavy part goes from 1 (never) to 6 (every sixth pass).

errors.match: core reuse and denoiser reuse cannot be combined
errors.title: Those two shortcuts cannot be used together.
errors.fix: Pick either reuse between passes or reuse of the heavy part, and leave the other at 1.

errors.match: SSD streaming uses original BF16 weights
errors.title: Those two settings do not work together.
errors.fix: Using less graphics memory reads the model in its original form, which the Apple M5 shortcut cannot use. Turn one of them off.

errors.match: int8 row FC2 cannot be combined with the BF16 MLP
errors.title: Those two settings do not work together.
errors.fix: The Apple M5 shortcut and the reference-exact maths are alternatives. Turn one of them off.

errors.match: full references cannot be combined with frame anchors
errors.title: Reference material and start or end photos are two different ways to work.
errors.fix: Either start and end on your own photos, or give references to draw from. Remove one of the two.

errors.match: Ref2VA supports at most 12 references
errors.title: That is more reference material than the model accepts.
errors.fix: Keep at most 12 items in total. Remove one before adding another.

errors.match: Ref2VA limits are 9 images, 3 videos, and 3 audio inputs
errors.title: Too much of one kind of reference.
errors.fix: At most 9 photos, 3 clips and 3 sounds. Remove one of the kind that is full.

errors.match: reference audio requires an image or video reference
errors.title: Sound needs something to go with.
errors.fix: Add a reference photo or clip beside the sound, or remove the sound.

errors.match: has no soundtrack path
errors.title: That clip is missing its soundtrack.
errors.fix: Choose the audio file that goes with the clip, or use the clip with its own sound instead.

errors.match: a video soundtrack requires at least 2 seconds
errors.title: The video is too short to carry the clip's sound.
errors.fix: A clip's sound is trimmed to the length of the video, and needs at least 2 seconds. Make the video at least 2.4 seconds long, or use the clip without its sound.

errors.match: requires at least 2 seconds: the clip is only
errors.title: That clip is too short to take sound from.
errors.fix: Use a clip of at least 2 seconds, or add it without its sound.

errors.match: reference audio requires at least 2 seconds at 32 kHz
errors.title: That sound is too short.
errors.fix: Reference sound has to last at least 2 seconds.

errors.match: ordered reference audio exceeds 15 seconds in total
errors.title: That is more sound than the model can take in.
errors.fix: All the reference sounds together have to fit in 15 seconds. Remove one, or use a shorter file.
